incidents.name: Juice JuiceStaking unbounded stake multiplier
incidents.notes: JuiceStaking.stake() accepted a caller-supplied second parameter that scales the reward accrual without any bound check, so a stake of a small JUICE position followed by harvest() one block later paid out the pool's entire JUICE balance.

sources.ref: onchain review: JuiceStaking 0x8584DdbD1E28bCA4bc6Fb96baFe39f850301940e (verified, ContractName JuiceStaking) created 2024-03-08T16:46:47Z by 0x181894edb3796bb68bf5e13ebf76c9ac4d2b790a, not the attack-tx sender 0x3fa19214705bc82ce4b898205157472a79d026be; no EIP-1967 Upgraded events, so the executing code was 13.3 hours old. ~54 ETH at a March 2024 ETH price near $3,900 is far above the $1,000 floor. Loss converted at the incident timestamp: 54 ETH x $3,927.30 (DefiLlama historical ETH price) = $212,074.
